text:
Sasha: Heads up — stream showing ~2s A/V lag and captions ~6s delayed. If you're on stage, please record locally as a fallback. Also quick leadership Q: will the 'fast-gen' latency target on the roadmap move from 50ms -> ~30ms?

Devon: seeing the same. encoder-01 CPU spiking, switching to backup encoder-02 now.

Ops-bot: /switch-encoder encoder-02 — success. observed latency delta: 1.9s -> 0.6s.

Leo: nice. captions still lagging. captioner queue ~420ms per phrase, restarting captioner now (`systemctl restart captioner.service`).

Anya: @Maria — capturing this for the Q&A: can you give a short public answer on the 'fast-gen' target for folks watching?

Maria: Short version: plan is to target 30-40ms for priority customers this quarter, 50ms baseline for general availability. We'll include exact numbers in the roadmap slide and follow-up doc.

Kyle: quick product question from the chat: is Private deployment getting more engineering cycles than Optimize next quarter?

Maria: Private is top-3 product priority. Optimize will get limited but focused perf work; we'll publish a prioritization blurb in the post-all-hands follow-up.

Devon: encoder swap stable. A/V lag down to ~0.5s. Recording is being saved to s3://redwood-allhands/2026-03-23/backup.mp4.

Infra-bot: Recording started at 1879001280. Local fallback saved to /tmp/allhands-backup.mp4.

Sasha: Thanks — please paste the public recording link when ready. Also, quick ask: can we call out in the follow-up deck any changes to rollout cadence (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)? That was a point of confusion in the chat.

Maria: Will add a slide in the deck post-call. Rollout cadence summary: Hosted minor updates weekly, Dedicated/Private on a monthly cadence with pre-scheduled maintenance windows. I'll send bullets after the call.

Anya: Capturing action items: 1) upload backup recording (Devon), 2) update deck with latency targets & rollout cadence (Maria), 3) send follow-up email with timelines and recording (Anya).

Devon: :thumbsup: upload done — https://storage.redwood.ai/allhands/1879001280-backup.mp4

Leo: :thumbsup: captions back to normal.

Sasha: Closing thread — huge thanks. We'll announce slides + recording in ~1 hour :clock1:
